install_steps: Download the gator archive for your platform from https://github.com/open-policy-agent/gatekeeper/releases (asset: gator-<ver>-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz) and extract to PATH
note: gator runs entirely locally — no cluster needed. 'gator verify' executes declarative suite.yaml files; 'gator test' evaluates a directory of constraint templates + constraints + objects directly.
